items.fact: The campaign has five chapters and 91 story missions, following Jason and Lucia through Leonida's criminal underworld.
Chapters 1 to 4 have 22, 11, 26 and 25 missions, and Chapter 5 has 7. Chapter 2 also has optional extra missions, and Chapter 3 has one.
The chapters are Just Like Paradise (Leonida Keys), Paradise Lost (Port Gellhorn), Tits, Ass, Drug Money, Vice City, Baby, and Top of the World, Ma. The last three are set in or around Vice City.
Chapter 2 ends with the mission Checking Out once you reach the Move to Vice City marker. Before leaving, pay off the motel manager Linda promptly, because delaying raises your checkout fee.
The two playable leads are Jason and Lucia, and many missions let you switch between them. Early missions also involve Donnie, Cal and Brian, and later ones involve Dre'Quan and Raul.
Leonida is divided into five counties. Named areas include Key Lento in Mariana County, Port Gellhorn, Hamlet, Grassrivers, Kelly County and Vice-Dale County, which contains Vice City.
There are 18 collectible card sets, which range from 12 to 36 cards each. You need to complete only 15 of them for 100% completion.
Nine1Nine has 36 cards in six rarity tiers. Selling the full set to any pawn shop pays $9,600.
The Progress menu lists more than 250 animals to find and collect. That is well above the 170-plus species Rockstar announced before launch.

The Chapter 2 Starlet Motel holds several missable collectibles, including the Vicki and Victor Maravilla cards and the books Help Me Help You Help Me and Wizard Wang. Grab them before the story moves you out.
Bobcat Dive Site, west of Grassrivers, hides six treasures. Find them with scuba gear and a metal detector, then sell them to Kenton.
The map has 40 unique race locations and 39 criminal hideouts. Races charge an entry fee and a possible vehicle rental fee, but a win nets a profit.
Large bank vault robberies pay up to $200,000. They unlock near the end of Chapter 4 after you complete the side quest That's Where The Money Is... and two Payday Loan jobs.
Moses (from Chapter 2) buys stolen cars that have no tracker. Randy (from Chapter 3) takes high-end cars from an 18-car wish list for $30,000 or more each.
Early on, a single convenience store or gas station stick-up yields a few hundred dollars. Your BuckMe account holds $15,000 and your savings $5,000, so extra cash in Chapter 1 stays in your pocket.
Stolen-car sales are limited by vehicle trackers and daily caps. Use the WAiNK app to check for trackers before you steal a car, because Moses won't buy tracked ones.

Ultimate Edition vehicles are unlocked through the story. The Dinka Enduro bike and Crest Kayak sit at Jason's house from Chapter 1, the '67 Dominator Buggy arrives in Chapter 2, and the Shitzu Squalo boat and '95 Grotti Cheetah follow in Chapters 4 and 5.
Before ditching Donnie's car in Chapter 1, take the H&L .38 Revolver from its trunk, because the chance disappears once the car is gone.
Hover over a robbery or hideout on the map to see its potential score, security level and key valuables. Bring your partner on bigger jobs.
The money cheat gives $250,000 but is meant for after the story. Using it stops saving and trophy or achievement progress for that session.

Update 01.002.002 went live on November 23, 2026. It fixes crashes, autosaving, weather that never changed, missing story phone calls, being unable to lose a Wanted Level, the gym deadlift bar, and partners not handing over bags to fences.
The locked-weather bug persists for some players despite the patch. One reported PS5 workaround is clearing the system cache from safe mode.
